# CommonsOps

> Work evidence and DAO payout attribution for recurring public maintenance on NEAR
> testnet. The registry binds claimant to recipient, freezes public PR + commit
> identity and links one Sputnik proposal. PAID is derived offchain from finalized
> causal transfer receipts, not approval. Work quality, authorship and merge status
> are not automatically verified.

Live app: https://super-user-root.github.io/CommonsOps/
Recorded proof, no RPC: https://super-user-root.github.io/CommonsOps/#journey
Website index: https://super-user-root.github.io/CommonsOps/llms.txt
Canonical source: https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/llms.txt

## Core documents

- [README](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/README.md): route table, setup, shared slot, evidence and scope.
- [Testnet journey](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/docs/testnet-journey.md): recorded successful transactions and causal 0.5 NEAR payout; shared slot and unsigned CLI examples.
- [Historical findings](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/docs/p4-t02-findings.md): dated agent-context findings, public rationale and bounded review scope, not external audit certification.
- [Release verification](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/docs/release-verification.md): exact deployed artifact and historical Windows byte-equality scope; Linux output differs.
- [Demo guide](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/demo/README.md): hosted URL, screenshot inventory and honest capture provenance; X post pending human publication.
- [Command reference](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/docs/COMMANDS.md): pinned toolchain/cache setup, gates, decoder, finite historical RPC, static export and CI.

## Code map

- [Contract entry](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/contracts/registry/src/lib.rs): templates, deterministic cycles, claims, immutable evidence, one-time proposal links and storage collateral.
- [Contract domain](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/contracts/registry/src/domain.rs): canonical input and evidence identity, not GitHub work verification.
- [Contract tests](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/contracts/registry/src/tests.rs): authorization, timing, storage, claim/release/submission and replay guards.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/packages/domain/src/index.ts): shared cycle/claim/evidence types and invariants.
- [Proposal builder](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/packages/near/src/proposal-builder.ts): unsigned add_proposal construction for the pinned Sputnik 2.0.0 builder profile. It does not construct act_proposal approval calls; 2.3.1 request building remains unsupported.
- [Payment verifier](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/packages/near/src/index.ts): separately supports the recorded Sputnik 2.3.1 payout profile; checks exact act_proposal and causal Transfer receipts.
- [Reconciliation engine](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/packages/near/src/reconciliation.ts): APPLIED / IDEMPOTENT / CONFLICT / NOT_APPLIED; local fingerprint is integrity-only, not authenticity or global receipt uniqueness.
- [Read-only transport](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/packages/near/src/read-only-rpc.ts): official primary/archival testnet endpoints, bounded attempts/body/JSON and monotonic deadlines, exact historical scopes and block identity checks.
- [Browser registry reads](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/apps/web/lib/live/registry-reads.ts): final-block-pinned enumeration, named failures, no fixture fallback.
- [Template selection](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/apps/web/lib/live/template-selection.ts): canonical contributor availability, active-claim/open-window preference and synchronous hiding/selection invalidation.
- [Guarded wallet send](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/apps/web/lib/live/transactions.ts): last-await snapshot/input/current-signer checks; no automatic transaction retry.
- [Web workspace](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/apps/web/app/page.tsx): short recorded tour with native disclosures, separate live registry and external operator/DAO handoffs.
- [Historical deployment check](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/scripts/smoke-testnet.mjs): exact recorded transaction, init block and deployed WASM checks.
- [Historical reconciliation](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/scripts/reconcile-live.mjs): re-derives fixed recorded payout expectations, not newly discovered registry linkage.
- [E2E replay](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/tests/e2e/e2e-replay.test.ts): deterministic recorded payout, reuse conflicts, idempotency and convergence.
- [Checked view decoder](https://github.com/super-user-root/CommonsOps/blob/main/tests/decode-rpc-view.ts): curl stdin envelope/UTF-8 byte-array validation, decoded JSON or nonzero failure.

## Verification routes

Set up Node 24.18.0, pnpm 11.25.0, Rust 1.98.0, rustfmt and wasm32-unknown-unknown.
Windows requires Visual Studio C++ build tools. Setup needs network access:

    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    cargo +1.98.0 fetch --locked --manifest-path contracts/registry/Cargo.toml
    pnpm verify:offline
    node --test tests/e2e/e2e-replay.test.ts

The ordinary native-Windows gate requires no drive mapping. Current suite counts
come from the runner. Controller/source/HTML tests are not browser focus/layout or
wallet-signing evidence. Fresh WASM gets structural/API checks; historical tests
use the checked immutable deployed fixture, never substitute arbitrary host bytes.

Historical, read-only, provider-dependent commands (no wallet or artifact writes):

    node scripts/smoke-testnet.mjs commonsops.testnet --stdout-only
    node scripts/reconcile-live.mjs --stdout-only

Success includes outer runProvenance; failure exits 1 with FAILED JSON on stderr.
The unchanged recorded snapshot fingerprint is
f1eed9bbbb82e63c2f96a5321b53dd85b9e7395bd54f556a93eccd8482719965.
Finite primary/archival retries do not promise uptime; recorded proof/replay is
not relabelled as fresh RPC success.

## Boundaries and provenance

- One global shared demo slot 2:0; first claimant occupies it. Only the active
  claimant can release before immutable evidence submission. No guaranteed payout.
  Availability follows the last verified block; recorded proof and offline replay
  are repeatable regardless of slot or network availability.
- No custody of DAO payout funds. Sputnik governs its treasury; registry storage
  collateral is retained, including excess, without a refund path.
- Source identity is a public PR/SHA reference, not authorship, merged status or
  quality proof. Public security fixes only after coordinated disclosure; no
  confidential vulnerability-report intake.
- Testnet only. Mainnet is refused in code and requires code/configuration,
  artifact/profile and operational validation. No keys in app code.
- foundation_status is legacy scaffold text, not business-state proof or evidence
  that lifecycle logic is missing.
- Deployed Windows artifact: 261226 bytes, SHA-256
  9376a482c740711803ce30b708221823721fdaef8e24196ca5b78976f8f9410c.
  Linux local build: 261082 bytes, SHA-256
  17266c2ad8f0da768dc8716730cf3ef70157ebe8fe62973d6259e195856300c7.
  Historical Windows clone/worktree equality does not imply cross-platform byte
  identity or behavioral equivalence; deployed pins remain exact.
- No token, AI approval, autonomous scheduler, generalized live payout indexer,
  new treasury, reputation system, Trezu integration or cross-chain payment.
  Human X publication, consent/submission and hosting retention are separate gates.
- License MIT; Social Money (social); AI assistance and baseline inputs disclosed
  in README. This canonical file is served unchanged by the forced-static website route.
